Action.description: An inert assignment or terminal action. Effects are applied atomically; no Python callbacks.
Action.title: Action

Argument.description: One named expression argument in a Function call.
Argument.title: Argument

Assembly.description: An Entity identifying a collection of Entities and Relationships. Members are referenced by identity and may belong to more than one Assembly. Membership does not imply spatial containment or duplicate its members.

characteristics.description: The Entity's labels and named values.

classification.description: Classification describing the object, referenced by its stable UUID.

code.description: Optional case-sensitive code unique among all Entities and Assemblies in the Model. Renaming it preserves UUID identity and references.

entities.description: Unordered, unique UUIDs of member Entities, including nested Assemblies.

id.description: Stable identity of the Entity, distinct from a Model revision.

name.description: Human-readable display name; not used as identity.

relationships.description: Unordered, unique UUIDs of member Relationships.

Assembly.title: Assembly

Assignment.description: An explicit scalar or Movement target and finite supplied Quantity; its collection determines assignment or estimate semantics.

quantity.description: Explicit finite magnitude and compatible units; omission or null is not a supplied amount.

Assignment.title: Assignment

Binding.description: A local interface name that refers to an existing canonical Value by UUID.

name.description: Case-sensitive local interface name; not reference identity.

value.description: UUID of the shared Value. Its declaration supplies its kind, Measure, and content.

Binding.title: Binding

Call.description: Application of an identified Function to positional and named expression arguments.

named_arguments.description: Named arguments with unique parameter names. Their order is retained for authoring, not positional binding.

Call.title: Call

Characteristics.description: A collection of Labels and Values belonging to an Entity or Relationship. Each Label or Value has a stable UUID and a key unique within its collection.

labels.description: Identified labels with explicit owner-local keys, unique within this collection.

values.description: Identified values with explicit owner-local keys, unique within this collection.

Characteristics.title: Characteristics

Claim.description: Sourced, asserted, or derived candidate content and its supporting lineage.

sources.description: Source Locations or UUID references to upstream Claims.

Claim.title: Claim

Classification.description: A named definition node in a taxonomy hierarchy.

code.description: Case-sensitive code unique within its Taxonomy; descriptive metadata, not reference identity.

definition.description: Optional explanatory text; an empty string is permitted.

id.description: Stable identity across code changes and Model revisions.

parent.description: Parent Classification in the same Taxonomy, referenced by UUID. An absent or null parent denotes a root candidate.

Classification.title: Classification

Constraint.description: An identified requirement that a referenced Boolean Expression be true in the context where the Constraint is imposed.

code.description: Optional case-sensitive code unique within its Constraint collection; not reference identity. Renaming it preserves UUID references.

description.description: Explanation of the requirement and its purpose.

id.description: Stable identity of the Constraint across Model revisions.

name.description: Human-readable display name; not used as identity.

predicate.description: UUID reference to the Expression required to be true. Reference existence and a Boolean result domain require semantic validation beyond record shape.

Constraint.title: Constraint

Content.description: Candidate content whose structure and meaning depend on the supported target. Content must be validated against that target before a Fact is accepted; this generic envelope does not make arbitrary content executable.
Content.title: Content

Criterion.description: Require an Entity Label with this owner-local key to include the exact Classification.
Criterion.title: Criterion

Decision.description: Recorded outcome of one evaluated decision point; absence of a rule means fallback.

termination_reason.description: Reason for termination, required when terminated is true.

Decision.title: Decision

DecisionPoint.description: One dated policy point with explicit observations, first-match rules and fallback.
DecisionPoint.title: DecisionPoint

Definitions.description: Reusable Taxonomies, Measures, and Functions identified by stable UUIDs within a Model.

functions.description: Exact versioned Function contracts used by calls in this Model. Implementations and their capabilities are selected separately.

Definitions.title: Definitions

Diagnostic.description: A coded finding and optional numerical evidence, qualified by document revision.

document.description: Revision containing the referenced target, or the document addressed as a whole.

message.description: Explanation and, for numerical findings, the checking convention.

references.description: Participating Values and Movements in this Run's input Model. Batch findings and attempts without a valid input Model cannot carry these references.

residual.description: Finite signed residual under the stated convention.

target.description: UUID of a canonical record in document; never an unqualified cross-revision reference.

tolerance.description: Finite nonnegative tolerance in compatible units.

Diagnostic.title: Diagnostic

Distribution.description: Serializable distribution parameters, with explicit units; no live random generator.
Distribution.title: Distribution

Domain.description: The permitted content of an argument or result, including its kind, compatible units, measurement meaning, and collection elements where applicable.

collection_kind.description: Optional collection shape required by this signature.

kind.description: The category of content permitted by this Domain.

measure.description: Optional exact measurement meaning required for a measurement or Flow.

units.description: Optional compatible units required for Quantity content. Omission leaves units unconstrained by the signature; a concrete Quantity still requires explicit units.

Domain.title: Domain

Entity.description: An identifiable domain object, such as an apartment, building, or actor. Its identity persists across immutable Model revisions. Loading its definition does not execute calculations.

characteristics.description: The Entity's labels and named values.

classification.description: Classification describing the object, referenced by its stable UUID.

code.description: Optional case-sensitive code unique among all Entities and Assemblies in the Model. Renaming it preserves UUID identity and references.

id.description: Stable identity of the Entity, distinct from a Model revision.

name.description: Human-readable display name; not used as identity.

Entity.title: Entity

Entry.description: A named text component of a source address.
Entry.title: Entry

Entry__identifier_optional.description: A named text component of a source address.
Entry__identifier_optional.title: Entry

Expression.description: An identified mathematical expression. Its kind determines its content; nested expressions retain order and UUID references resolve in the applicable Model or composed Specification scope.

boolean.description: Boolean literal; false is a literal, not absence.

id.description: Stable identity of this Expression across Model revisions.

operand.description: Operand of unary negation or Boolean negation.

operands.description: Two ordered operands of a binary operator. Unary operators use operand; Function calls use their own signature.

quantity.description: Numerical literal with an explicit magnitude and units, independent of any Measure. Use dimensionless for unitless content. Zero is a literal, not absence.

target.description: Explicit Value or Movement symbol; never implicit recorded content.

Expression.title: Expression

Fact.description: Supporting Claims for the recorded state of one graph object or characteristic.

claims.description: Unique UUIDs of supporting Claims; at least one is required.

target.description: The actual graph object or characteristic being supported, referenced by its stable UUID.

Fact.title: Fact

Filter.description: Conjunctive filters over fixed Entity metadata. No numerical expression or solved amount determines membership.

labels.description: All listed Label conditions must hold.

Filter.title: Filter

Flow.description: Ordered temporal quantities owned by one Value. Dates are coordinates, not units. Empty, unresolved and zero movements are distinct. The overall model logic defines the meaning of the quantities and selects their calculations; a Flow carries no semantic kind or basis.
Flow.title: Flow

Formulation.description: An identified mathematical container with explicit local declarations, expressions, and asserted constraints. Formulations may contain child Formulations and bind names to shared Values.

bindings.description: Local interface names referring to existing Values, including local Values.

code.description: Optional case-sensitive code unique among sibling Formulations; not reference identity.

constraints.description: Canonical assertions owned by this Formulation, referencing Boolean Expressions by UUID.

description.description: Explanation of the mathematical purpose of this Formulation.

expressions.description: Root Expressions owned by this Formulation; their nested operands remain owned within their expression trees. Constraints may reference any eligible Expression in the applicable scope.

formulations.description: Canonical child Formulations owned by this Formulation. Repeated or cyclic containment is invalid.

id.description: Stable identity of this Formulation across Model revisions.

values.description: Canonical declarations owned by this Formulation. Values already owned elsewhere are referenced, not repeated here.

Formulation.title: Formulation

Function.description: An identified, versioned contract for a pure mathematical or domain function, independent of a particular runtime implementation.

empty_collection.description: Required for functions with collection arguments. Zero is permitted only when the result domain and units can be established without reading a member.

parameters.description: Ordered signature. Omission denotes no parameters.

semantics.description: Mathematical meaning, argument conventions, domain restrictions, and exceptional cases.

unit_rule.description: How result units follow from the arguments, or why units do not apply. This rule requires semantic implementation; prose is not an executable unit checker.

Function.title: Function

Implementation.description: An implementation role and its reproducible software identity as reported for this execution.

version.description: Nonblank version or immutable build identifier.

Implementation.title: Implementation

Label.description: A named set of Classifications describing an aspect of an Entity or Relationship.

classifications.description: Unique UUID references to Classifications describing this aspect.

id.description: Stable identity of the Label, used by provenance Facts.

key.description: Name unique within the owner's characteristics.labels collection.

Label.title: Label

Location.description: An address within a specific Source edition.

address.description: Named address parts, such as sheet and cell, with nonblank text values.

Location.title: Location

Measure.description: An identified definition of a measurable characteristic and its canonical units.

code.description: Case-sensitive code unique within the Model’s Measure collection; not reference identity.

definition.description: Optional explanatory text describing the measurement convention.

id.description: Stable identity of this Measure definition.

name.description: Nonblank human-readable name of the measured characteristic.

tags.description: Unordered, nonblank descriptive terms, with no duplicates.

units.description: Nonblank expression specifying the canonical units for quantities interpreted through this Measure, such as m^2 or AUD/year. Unitless quantities must have an explicit dimensionless convention.

Measure.title: Measure

Measurement.description: An identified measurable property with a Measure and an optional Quantity.

id.description: Stable identity of the Measurement, used by provenance Facts.

measure.description: Measure defining meaning and canonical units, referenced by its stable UUID.

quantity.description: Optional recorded numerical content. Its units must be compatible with the Measure's canonical units. Omission or null denotes unresolved content.

Measurement.title: Measurement

Metadata.description: Identity, description, and optional lineage of one immutable document revision.

description.description: Optional explanation of this revision and its purpose.

id.description: UUID identifying the enclosing immutable document revision.

name.description: Optional human-readable name of this revision.

previous.description: UUID of the preceding revision of the same document kind, referencing its Metadata.

schema_version.description: Version of the enclosing document's schema contract.

Metadata.title: Metadata

Method.description: The named process used to assert, derive, or reconcile evidence.
Method.title: Method

Model.description: A self-contained snapshot of a system's declarations, mathematical formulations, and recorded content, identified by its Metadata.

definitions.description: Canonical Taxonomy, Measure, and Function definitions referenced by this snapshot.

metadata.description: Required identity, schema contract version, and optional descriptive/history fields.

provenance.description: Evidence and reasoning supporting recorded domain and Value content in this snapshot.

system.description: The domain objects and explicit mathematical formulations represented by this Model.

Model.title: Model

Movement.description: One numerical entry in a Flow, associated with a date or period. The overall model logic determines its meaning. At least one of date or period is required. With a period, date records an independent payment or observation date and need not lie inside the period. Derived boundary dates are calculated, not stored. UUID identifies the Movement independently of dates and optional matching keys. Repeated event dates require distinct nonblank keys; keys are not reference identity. Magnitude omission/null means unresolved. Claims retain source or derivation evidence.

id.description: Stable Movement identity across Model revisions. Derived numerical results receive fresh identities.

key.description: Optional event matching key and readable label; never reference identity.

Movement.title: Movement

Objective.description: A scalar numerical Expression and the sense in which its result is preferred.

expression.description: UUID of a scalar numerical Expression in the composed Model and Specification scope.

sense.description: Whether smaller or larger results are preferred.

Objective.title: Objective

ObservationAvailability.description: Earliest date a recorded Value or Movement may be supplied to a policy.
ObservationAvailability.title: ObservationAvailability

ObservationBinding.description: An explicit observation target. An optional date may delay availability but cannot advance it.
ObservationBinding.title: ObservationBinding

ObservedQuantity.description: The exact quantity and availability supplied to a decision.
ObservedQuantity.title: ObservedQuantity

Parameter.description: A named argument in a Function signature. List order determines positional argument order.

kind.description: How a call may supply this parameter.

required.description: Whether a call must supply this argument.

Parameter.title: Parameter

Period.description: Half-open interval [start, end). Date boundaries use the Gregorian calendar; start must precede end.
Period.title: Period

Policy.description: Finite policy owning explicit controlled targets and ordered dated decision points.
Policy.title: Policy

Projection.description: Select Entity identities or Values belonging to each matching Entity.

measure.description: Select Values with this exact Measure.

Projection.title: Projection

PropertyContent.description: Tagged inert content. Scalar text preserves exact type and representation, including negative zero. Containers never instantiate arbitrary Python classes. Conditional shape and canonical scalar grammar are checked semantically.
PropertyContent.title: PropertyContent

Provenance.description: Facts connecting graph objects to supporting Claims, with the Sources and upstream Claims needed to follow their lineage.
Provenance.title: Provenance

Quantity.description: Numerical content consisting of a finite magnitude and explicit units.

magnitude.description: Finite numerical magnitude expressed in the accompanying units.

units.description: Explicit units for this magnitude, such as m^2, AUD/year, or dimensionless.

Quantity.title: Quantity

Query.description: A non-executing query specification returning Entity or Value identities from the containing Model revision.

steps.description: Ordered traversal steps; omission selects the starting Entity.

Query.title: Query

RandomStream.description: Stable component stream identity derived from seed, scenario key and component name.
RandomStream.title: RandomStream

Reconciliation.description: Explicit selection of one supporting Claim when evidence conflicts.

selected.description: UUID of a Claim included in the Fact's claims.

Reconciliation.title: Reconciliation

Reference.description: A Value or Movement UUID resolved in the containing Model or composed Specification. Execution diagnostic references resolve in the Run's input Model. Names, matching keys and positions are never identities.

target.description: UUID of a Value or Movement declaration in the applicable scope.

Reference.title: Reference

Relationship.description: An identified, directed connection from one Entity to another. Its classification describes the connection; its characteristics describe properties of the connection itself.

characteristics.description: Labels and Values describing this connection.

classification.description: Classification describing the object, referenced by its stable UUID.

id.description: Stable identity of the Relationship across Model revisions.

Relationship.title: Relationship

Report.description: Outcome, actual runtime, findings, and ordered execution trace of a Run.

diagnostics.description: Unordered findings supporting interpretation of the outcome.

runtime.description: Actual runtime when known; may be absent for a skipped or pre-execution failure.

trace.description: Ordered execution and selection records; list order is preserved.

Report.title: Report

Rule.description: One ordered Boolean condition and its atomic actions.
Rule.title: Rule

Run.description: The finalized record of one execution attempt against an exact Specification revision.

metadata.description: Identity and schema version of this immutable Run record.

outputs.description: Unique accepted output Model revision references, or their union for a batch.

spawns.description: Unique references to directly spawned Run revisions.

specification.description: Exact attempted Specification revision, resolved as a Specification document.

Run.title: Run

Runtime.description: Observed timing, implementation identities, and effective numerical settings.

finished_at.description: Observed finish instant with an explicit timezone.

implementations.description: Actual implementation identities; nonempty when Runtime is present.

settings.description: Effective numerical settings, rather than merely copied requests.

started_at.description: Observed start instant with an explicit timezone.

Runtime.title: Runtime

ScenarioParameter.description: One named constant or sampled parameter; exactly one input is required by semantic validation.
ScenarioParameter.title: ScenarioParameter

ScenarioPlan.description: Finite market generation plan. This is input-generation provenance, not governing mathematics.
ScenarioPlan.title: ScenarioPlan

ScenarioRealization.description: Captured scenario inputs and paths. Stored draws permit replay without random sampling.
ScenarioRealization.title: ScenarioRealization

Selection.description: Read a declared member or indexed element from structured expression content.
Selection.title: Selection

Settings.description: Numerical convergence and resource settings; the containing record distinguishes requested from effective values.

iteration_limit.description: Maximum number of solver iterations requested, interpreted by the backend's documented algorithm.

relative_tolerance.description: Positive finite dimensionless convergence tolerance, strictly less than one.

time_limit.description: Positive finite execution time limit in seconds, using the backend's documented timing convention.

Settings.title: Settings

Source.description: An identifiable edition of an external evidence artifact.

checksum.description: Content checksum identifying the evidence edition.

Source.title: Source

Span.description: Named extent, using the same half-open boundary convention as Period.
Span.title: Span

Specification.description: An immutable contribution of investigation requirements, a composition of such contributions, or a batch of separate Specifications. A concrete composition investigates one pinned Model revision.

assignments.description: Explicit Quantities held fixed on their target Values for this investigation.

cases.description: Unique Metadata UUIDs of separate Specifications in a batch, without implicit inheritance.

estimates.description: Initial numerical estimates for unknown Values, used to initialize a solve without fixing them.

formulations.description: Additional mathematical declarations and constraints owned by this Specification. Root codes are unique within this collection, independently of the Model's root Formulation codes.

includes.description: Unique Metadata UUIDs of Specification revisions contributing requirements to this investigation.

metadata.description: Identity and schema version of this Specification revision, with optional description and lineage.

model.description: UUID of the exact input Model revision. Optional on a contribution; required after composing a concrete investigation. On a batch it only asserts every case's independently supplied input Model.

objectives.description: Objectives in decreasing order of preference. Implementations may use this order for automatic selection; candidate exploration and final selection are implementation responsibilities.

settings.description: Optional numerical requests. Choices still unspecified after composition are left to the implementation; the Run records the effective settings.

unknowns.description: Unique scalar or Movement unknowns; explicit and disjoint from assignments and policy targets.

Specification.title: Specification

Status.description: Execution completion and mathematical conclusion, recorded independently.

completion.description: How this attempt ended, or the aggregate completion of a batch.

Status.title: Status

Step.description: One ordered record of execution activity, without prescribing scheduling or policy logic.

at.description: Observed event instant with an explicit timezone.

document.description: Revision containing the referenced target, or the document addressed as a whole.

message.description: What occurred and the basis for any selection.

target.description: UUID of a canonical record in document; never an unqualified cross-revision reference.

Step.title: Step

System.description: The Entities, Relationships, Assemblies, and mathematical formulations of a Model.

assemblies.description: Canonical Assemblies with UUID references to shared domain members.

entities.description: Canonical domain Entities, excluding Assemblies stored in their own collection.

formulations.description: Canonical root Formulations containing governing mathematical declarations and constraints.

relationships.description: Canonical directed connections between Entities, including Assemblies.

System.title: System

Taxonomy.description: A named, single-root hierarchy of Classifications.

classifications.description: Identified Classifications belonging to this Taxonomy; codes are unique within the collection.

code.description: Case-sensitive code unique in the Model's taxonomy catalogue.

Taxonomy.title: Taxonomy

Traversal.description: One traversal step over domain Relationships or Assembly membership.

classification.description: Exact Classification of Relationships to follow.

Traversal.title: Traversal

Value.description: An identified, typed Value belonging to an Entity or Relationship's Characteristics, or declared locally within a mathematical Formulation. Its key provides a name within the owner's values collection; its UUID identifies the symbol independently of that name.

description.description: Explanation of the meaning of this Value within its owner.

id.description: Stable identity of the Value, used by provenance Facts.

key.description: Nonblank name unique within the owner's values collection; not reference identity.

kind.description: The kind of content represented by this characteristic.

measure.description: Measure defining meaning and canonical units, referenced by its stable UUID.

quantity.description: Optional recorded numerical content. Its units must be compatible with the Measure's canonical units. Omission or null denotes unresolved content.

Value.title: Value
